title: Write the missing README for packages/claude-code-plugin
description: packages/claude-code-plugin is the only host package with no README — the root README's Hosts table links to the bare directory while the other three rows link to a README.md. Write it in the same shape as packages/cursor-plugin/README.md: what the plugin ships (hooks/hooks.json with the PreToolUse spawn deny and the SessionStart hook, six generated skills, the sober MCP server), how to install it, and what is different from the other hosts — this is the only host that enforces the block in-session. Two install paths are true and both must appear: `/plugin marketplace add memoksin/sober` then `/plugin install sober@sober` (Claude Code clones the repo itself — no manual clone, which is what .claude-plugin/marketplace.json at the root already supports), and the settings.json route via extraKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins for a team that wants the plugin present on checkout. State the `sober` on PATH prerequisite, because hooks.json shells out to `sober hook spawn` and `sober hook session`. Close with the same "do not edit the skills here" paragraph the other three carry.

brief.approach: Create `packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md` using the structure and register of `packages/cursor-plugin/README.md`, `packages/codex-plugin/README.md`, and `packages/opencode-plugin/README.md`. Describe the shipped `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` metadata, `hooks/hooks.json` (`PreToolUse` spawn guard and `SessionStart` board hook), generated six-skill set, and MCP server declaration. Document both repository-backed installation paths already supported by `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: the interactive `/plugin marketplace add memoksin/sober` followed by `/plugin install sober@sober`, and the team-managed `settings.json` form using `extraKnownMarketplaces` plus `enabledPlugins`; state once that `npm i -g @besober/cli` must put `sober` on PATH because both hooks and the MCP declaration execute it. Explain the Claude-specific behavior: it is the only host package with in-session hook enforcement, its MCP client can elicit decisions, and attended dispatch is supported. End with the standard generated-skill warning copied in substance from the other host READMEs. Keep this node to the new package README; inspect `README.md` only to keep terminology aligned and do not change the root install guide owned by `a-per-host-install-section-in-the-readme-ykg6`.

acceptance.run: test -f packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md && git grep -q 'plugin marketplace add memoksin/sober' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md && git grep -q 'plugin install sober@sober' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md
acceptance.proves: The missing host README exists and contains the supported no-manual-clone marketplace installation commands.

acceptance.run: git grep -q 'extraKnownMarketplaces' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md && git grep -q 'enabledPlugins' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md && git grep -q 'npm i -g @besober/cli' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md
acceptance.proves: The team settings route and the executable PATH prerequisite are documented.

acceptance.run: git grep -q 'PreToolUse' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md && git grep -q 'SessionStart' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md && git grep -q 'pnpm plugins' -- packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md
acceptance.proves: Claude Code's hook behavior and the generated-skill editing rule are explained.

acceptance.run: git diff --exit-code development -- README.md && test "$(git diff --name-only development -- packages/claude-code-plugin README.md)" = 'packages/claude-code-plugin/README.md'
acceptance.proves: The node adds only the missing package README and does not overlap the separate root installation-guide node.
The repository's Markdown and secret checks remain clean.
